analysis.headline: Microsoft rushes emergency .NET patches for critical Brotli flaw
analysis.summary: Microsoft released emergency .NET security updates to patch a critical vulnerability in the Brotli compression library, also tracked as HTTP2Shell, which could let attackers corrupt memory and access sensitive data. Microsoft joins a growing list of software maintainers scrambling to patch the compression flaw.
